title: Server2 rainfall hit-rate handover
scenario: F2 build17, source snapshot 3a31a023f21c4e7f62593e7b0b5ffd735518be0a. Prepare a future handover using actual owned local results. Use the protected hashed binary and a fresh output directory. Screenshots display retained receipts, not an additional execution or production approval.

steps.title: Verify the cumulative normal flow
steps.instruction: Run tools/rainfall_handover_smoke.py with --binary pointing to the qualified example and --output pointing to a new owned directory. Keep original ObjectIds and seed totals. Only canonical rain predictions are eligible; observed-dry is a miss. Check inactive zero-write behavior, one acknowledged increment, repeat/fresh-process idempotence, the later dry window and corrupt-authority partial statistics.
steps.caption: Actual build17: six HTTP200 responses; 3/4 inactive, 4/5 once and after repeat/reconstruction, then 4/6. Full bodies match build16.
steps.expected: No repeated-window increment and no stale seed total after corrupt authority. Fixed clock, denied providers and owned S3; no production or signal test.

steps.title: Verify the physical input and actual drain
steps.instruction: Repeat with --pressure page and a fresh output directory. Preserve the original 46 raw records and 16MiB corpus. Allow only an acknowledged result before the existing Source cutoff; otherwise omit unconfirmed statistics and S16 inputs. Wait for actual owner drain, retire the old child and read the same S3 authority from a fresh process without reactivation.
steps.caption: Actual build17: active HTTP200 in 0.790s with acknowledged 3/5; drain and fresh-process readback retain exactly the same checkpoint.
steps.expected: Observed active whole-child peak RSS 364,494,848 bytes. This is not a hard heap/RSS limit, production throughput or exact final-wire-flush proof.

steps.title: Review activation and recovery separately
steps.instruction: Keep legacy authoritative until its approved shutdown boundary. Preview the exact seed, namespace, epoch, high-water evidence and first eligible window. Both verify and activate require complete exact imported S06 seed proof even if a local file matches. Runtime never creates absent authority. Before an authorized switch, qualify both complete recovery bundles with checkpoint receipts, final-registration markers, claims and forecastNarrative.
steps.caption: Current tests and binary/source identities bind the local record. The owned operator prerequisite/readback test passed; no production activation occurred.
steps.expected: Separate 128 read tickets from eight mutation intents; join the same grid/end, independently validate input scope and preserve original deadlines. No checkpoint rewind or automatic resend.
